summary: The snacks sitting in most kids' lunchboxes right now have more dye and added sugar than most parents realize. I used to think the biggest offenders were the obvious ones.
caption: The snacks sitting in most kids' lunchboxes right now have more dye and added sugar than most parents realize. 😬 I used to think the biggest offenders were the obvious ones. Candy, soda, dessert. But when I actually started reading labels it was the everyday stuff that surprised me the most. The yogurt pouch. The granola bar. The juice box that says "made with real fruit" on the front. My kids eat vegetables before most families have had breakfast. That didn't happen by accident and it didn't happen overnight. It started with paying attention to what I was putting in front of them every single day. Small consistent choices compound over time. What your kids eat on a random Tuesday in October matters more than the birthday cake at the party on Saturday. Follow for daily tips on feeding your family healthier options.
